title: mnstry.atelier-project-config@v1
description: Portable project adapter config for resolving a workspace, graph inputs, boundaries, and generated Atelier projections. Machine-local paths belong in ignored local overlays.

kind.description: Reserved value "external" marks a git folder the workspace acknowledges but does not manage: no read boundary is implied, and it is excluded from graph walking, sidecar requirements, projection, and boundary enforcement.

identity.description: Provider-stable repository identity. Names change and hosting providers redirect the old URL indefinitely, so a name alone cannot tell "same repo, renamed" from "different repo". Never substitute the root commit: repos created from one template share it.
